groups.label: Wyoming Wildlife & Access
groups.description: Hunter Management Areas, Walk-In Areas, and public-access easements managed by Wyoming Game & Fish Department (WGFD). Data sourced from WGFD open data.

layers.name: Hunter Management Areas (WGFD)
layers.description: WGFD Hunter Management Areas are private lands with WGFD access agreements open to licensed hunters. Access is permitted during the agreement period. HMA enrollment changes annually — verify current boundaries and rules with WGFD before hunting.
layers.attribution: Wyoming Game & Fish Department — Hunter Management Areas

layers.name: Walk-In Areas (WGFD)
layers.description: Wyoming Walk-In Area program lands — private properties with WGFD access agreements open to hunting during program season. Enrollment changes annually. Verify current maps with WGFD.
layers.attribution: Wyoming Game & Fish Department — Walk-In Area Program

layers.name: Public Access Easements (WGFD)
layers.description: Parcels with public access easements held by WGFD. Public may enter for hunting and recreation even though underlying ownership may be private. Verify easement terms with WGFD.
layers.attribution: Wyoming Game & Fish Department — Public Access Easements

groups.label: Wyoming State Land
groups.description: State Trust Land managed by the Wyoming Office of State Lands and Investments (OSLI). Unlike Colorado, Wyoming state trust land is generally open to public access and hunting under Wyoming law (W.S. 36-5-105).

layers.name: State Trust Land (OSLI)
layers.description: Wyoming State Trust Land parcels. Generally open to public hunting under Wyoming law — different from most other states. Some parcels may be closed by grazing lease or state order; verify with OSLI.
layers.attribution: Wyoming Office of State Lands and Investments — Open Data

groups.label: Wyoming Hunting Areas
groups.description: WGFD Game Management District and hunting area boundaries. These define where specific licenses are valid — not land-access boundaries.

layers.name: Game Management Districts (WGFD)
layers.description: Wyoming Game Management Districts for deer, elk, antelope, and other big game species. Your license is valid in specific districts — verify your district before hunting.
layers.attribution: Wyoming Game & Fish Department — Game Management Districts

layers.name: Checkerboard Ownership
layers.description: Wyoming checkerboard land — alternating BLM/private sections common in southwest Wyoming. Corner-crossing legality between diagonal BLM sections is contested. Shown to flag areas requiring extra care.
layers.attribution: BLM Wyoming — Land Ownership; Wyoming GIS
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105
